title: Agent Control Command Contract
description: Input shape for scripts/control_contract_audit.mjs — a normalized description of the operator control verbs (steer/interrupt/pause/kill/checkpoint/fork), which backends support them, and where command authorization reads its truth from.

verbs.description: Every operator control verb modeled as a distinct claim. interrupt, pause, kill, and steer must each appear as their own entry — see the collapsed-verbs finding.

name.description: e.g. steer, interrupt, pause, kill, checkpoint, fork.

terminalStates.description: Which delivery-lifecycle states this verb's commands can settle into. Must be a subset of the six allowed states; delivered/acknowledged/failed/expired are required for every verb.

backends.description: Every agent-body backend a command might target (local same-UID process, remote Cloudflare body, hook-only session, observed import, ...).

supportedVerbs.description: Verb names this backend can actually execute. A verb absent here means the backend cannot perform it and must expose an honest 'unsupported' terminal instead.

authorizationSource.description: Where a control command's authorization check reads its truth from at the moment of authorization. authoritative-lease/authoritative-event read live daemon state; cached-projection/ui-state can be stale by construction and must never authorize a command.

matrix.description: Cross product of verb x backend proving (or disproving) a real, distinct delivery lifecycle for that combination. Every combination a backend claims to support, and every combination it does not, needs a cell here — an absent cell is treated as an unproven gap, not a pass.

hasDistinctTerminalStates.description: True only if this verb/backend pair has its own tracked terminal-state sequence, not one collapsed with another verb's outcome.
